message.content: {"caption":"Two side-by-side radar charts compare Base, PPO, and GRPO scores across three benchmarks for LLaMA-3.1-8B and Qwen-2.5-7B.","description":"The figure contains two nine-axis radar charts, with a shared radial scale marked from 0 to 70 in increments of 10. Each chart has three polygon series: Base (blue), PPO (orange), and GRPO (green); the legend appears in both panels. The left panel is labeled LLaMA-3.1-8B and the right panel Qwen-2.5-7B. In each panel, the axes proceed clockwise from the top: LoCoMo F1, LoCoMo B1, LoCoMo J, MSC F1, MSC B1, MSC J, LongMemEval F1, LongMemEval B1, and LongMemEval J. There are no printed values at the vertices; values in chart_values are estimated from the radial grid. In both panels PPO and GRPO are generally above Base, with PPO usually the highest and GRPO usually between PPO and Base. The clearest separation is on the Qwen-2.5-7B LoCoMo F1 axis, where PPO is notably higher than Base.
